requirements.quote: An endpoint maintains a set of connection IDs received from its peer, any of which it can use when sending packets.
requirements.condition: While maintaining connection IDs supplied by a peer and sending packets to that peer.
requirements.required_behavior: Maintain the peer-supplied connection IDs as a set of available connection IDs from which an ID can be selected for sending packets.
requirements.why_checkable: The implementation's connection-ID state and its packet-sending selection can be inspected to verify that received IDs are tracked and available for use.

requirements.quote: When the endpoint wishes to remove a connection ID from use, it sends a RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frame to its peer.
requirements.condition: When an endpoint removes a connection ID from use.
requirements.required_behavior: Send a RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frame for that connection ID to the peer.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can trigger local removal of a connection ID and observe whether the corresponding retirement frame is sent.

requirements.quote: Sending a RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frame indicates that the connection ID will not be used again
requirements.condition: After an endpoint sends a RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frame for a connection ID.
requirements.why_checkable: Packets sent after the retirement frame can be inspected for reuse of the retired connection ID.

requirements.quote: Sending a RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frame indicates that the connection ID will not be used again and requests that the peer replace it with a new connection ID using a NEW_CONNECTION_ID frame.
requirements.condition: When a peer processes a RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frame.
requirements.required_behavior: Replace the retired connection ID by supplying a new connection ID in a NEW_CONNECTION_ID frame.
requirements.why_checkable: The described retirement request and replacement mechanism directly identify the expected observable response, although the passage does not state a strict deadline.

requirements.quote: endpoints limit the use of a connection ID to packets sent from a single local address to a single destination address.
requirements.condition: When an endpoint sends packets using a connection ID.
requirements.required_behavior: Associate use of that connection ID with one local-address and destination-address pair.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Use the same connection ID for packets sent from multiple local addresses or to multiple destination addresses.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet traces can correlate each connection ID with the local and destination address pair on which it is used.

requirements.quote: Endpoints SHOULD retire connection IDs when they are no longer actively using either the local or destination address for which the connection ID was used.
requirements.condition: When an endpoint is no longer actively using either the local address or the destination address associated with a connection ID.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can discontinue use of either associated address and verify that the endpoint initiates retirement of the connection ID.

requirements.quote: Such an endpoint can cause its peer to retire connection IDs by sending a NEW_CONNECTION_ID frame with an increased Retire Prior To field.
requirements.condition: When an endpoint needs its peer to retire previously issued connection IDs.
requirements.required_behavior: Send a NEW_CONNECTION_ID frame whose Retire Prior To field is increased to indicate the connection IDs to retire.
requirements.why_checkable: The emitted frame type and whether its Retire Prior To value increased are directly observable.

requirements.quote: The endpoint SHOULD continue to accept the previously issued connection IDs until they are retired by the peer.
requirements.condition: After requesting retirement of previously issued connection IDs and before the peer retires them.
requirements.required_behavior: Continue accepting those previously issued connection IDs.
requirements.why_checkable: A peer can continue sending on an indicated ID before retiring it, allowing acceptance behavior to be observed.

requirements.quote: If the endpoint can no longer process the indicated connection IDs, it MAY close the connection.
requirements.condition: If the endpoint can no longer process connection IDs indicated for retirement.
requirements.error_behavior: The endpoint is permitted to close the connection.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can make indicated IDs unprocessable and observe whether the implementation uses the permitted connection-close response.

requirements.quote: Upon receipt of an increased Retire Prior To field, the peer MUST stop using the corresponding connection IDs
requirements.condition: Upon receiving a NEW_CONNECTION_ID frame with an increased Retire Prior To field.
requirements.required_behavior: Stop using the connection IDs corresponding to the increased Retire Prior To value.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Send further packets using those connection IDs.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet traces after receipt of the increased value can detect any continued use of the corresponding IDs.

requirements.quote: Upon receipt of an increased Retire Prior To field, the peer MUST stop using the corresponding connection IDs and retire them with RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frames
requirements.condition: Upon receiving a NEW_CONNECTION_ID frame with an increased Retire Prior To field.
requirements.required_behavior: Send RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frames to retire the corresponding connection IDs.
requirements.why_checkable: The required retirement frames and their referenced connection IDs are observable on the wire.

requirements.quote: the peer MUST stop using the corresponding connection IDs and retire them with RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frames before adding the newly provided connection ID to the set of active connection IDs.
requirements.condition: Upon receiving an increased Retire Prior To value together with a newly provided connection ID.
requirements.required_behavior: Stop using and retire all corresponding connection IDs before adding the newly provided connection ID to the active set.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Add the newly provided connection ID to the active set before the corresponding old IDs have been stopped and retired.
requirements.why_checkable: Instrumentation or a focused test can observe retirement actions and active-set insertion to verify their required ordering.

requirements.quote: An endpoint SHOULD limit the number of connection IDs it has retired locally for which RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frames have not yet been acknowledged.
requirements.condition: While RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frames for locally retired connection IDs remain unacknowledged.
requirements.required_behavior: Bound the number of such locally retired connection IDs retained in the unacknowledged-retirement state.
requirements.why_checkable: The count of locally retired IDs with unacknowledged retirement frames can be inspected under sustained retirement and acknowledgment loss.

requirements.quote: An endpoint SHOULD allow for sending and tracking a number of RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frames of at least twice the value of the active_connection_id_limit transport parameter.
requirements.condition: When provisioning capacity to send and track RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frames.
requirements.required_behavior: Support sending and tracking at least two times the negotiated active_connection_id_limit value in RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frames.
requirements.why_checkable: A stress test can compare the implementation's retirement-frame tracking capacity with twice the transport-parameter value.

requirements.quote: An endpoint MUST NOT forget a connection ID without retiring it
requirements.condition: When an endpoint discards or forgets a connection ID.
requirements.required_behavior: Retire the connection ID before forgetting it.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Forget a connection ID that has not been retired.
requirements.why_checkable: Connection-ID lifecycle state can be inspected to ensure every discarded ID first enters the retired state.

requirements.quote: it MAY choose to treat having connection IDs in need of retirement that exceed this limit as a connection error of type CONNECTION_ID_LIMIT_ERROR.
requirements.condition: When the number of connection IDs needing retirement exceeds the retirement handling limit described in the paragraph.
requirements.error_behavior: The endpoint is permitted to treat the condition as a connection error of type CONNECTION_ID_LIMIT_ERROR.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can exceed the retirement handling limit and verify the type of any resulting connection error.

requirements.quote: Endpoints SHOULD NOT issue updates of the Retire Prior To field before receiving RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frames that retire all connection IDs indicated by the previous Retire Prior To value.
requirements.condition: After issuing a Retire Prior To value and before receiving retirement frames for every connection ID it indicates.
requirements.required_behavior: Wait until RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frames have been received for all connection IDs indicated by the previous value before issuing another Retire Prior To update.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Issue a Retire Prior To update while any connection ID indicated by the previous Retire Prior To value has not yet been retired by a received RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frame.
requirements.why_checkable: A trace can compare Retire Prior To updates with receipt of retirement frames for all IDs covered by the preceding value.
